integrity: The Lozi normalization, classical parameters, fixed-point formulas, and symbolic left/right framework were checked against primary and modern same-object sources. The complete Collet–Levy invariant-measure article was inspected across all 21 pages, including its invariant-measure construction, ergodic/Bernoulli results, and dimension section. The accepted amplitude law and one-sided-support rigidity were reconstructed independently from invariance and affine-branch hyperbolicity, and the exact algebra was replayed with the packaged checker. No numerical orbit experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives stationary first-moment and sign constraints but does not prove existence or uniqueness of an SBR measure for every allowed parameter pair.
The exact simplex controls sign-weighted amplitudes rather than sign probabilities.
The complete Rychlik chapter was not securely available in the inspected source.
A differently phrased elementary moment identity could remain in unindexed Lozi-map literature.
title: Exact stationary sign-amplitude simplex and two-sided recurrence in the Lozi map
